leadText: Volume 2 is the second volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 2 is the second volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Les retrouvailles (« Reunion »)
Premier combat d'Arène! (« First Gym battle! »)
La Brume des Rêves (« Mist of Dreams »)
Tournage compromis (« Compromised shooting »)
L'Arène de papier (« Paper Gym »)
Le secret d'Aloé (« Aloé's secret »)
À la poursuite des os de Pokémon (« Pursuit of Pokémon bones »)
L'infranchissable défense du duo (« The impenetrable defense of the duo »)
 
==Gym battles==
 defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Cilan, Chili, and Cress in PS470.
Lenora in PS474.
